bundle_report.acceptance: Provisional offline candidate. No runtime installation, original-game similarity target, native 96x77 resource alias binding, full UI acceptance, or whole graphics acceptance.
bundle_report.crop_policy: Largest exact 105*k by 94*k rectangle, k=min(source_width/105,source_height/94) using integer division; k>=8. Center with floor offsets, discarding odd extra pixels on right/bottom. Copy crop without resampling to a zero-based NRGBA image before filtering; no stretch or upscaling.
bundle_report.opacity: Every decoded source pixel must have alpha 255, including discarded overscan; all exports remain opaque. No alpha editing, background flattening, or magenta key treatment.
bundle_report.resampling: Unchanged resizeLanczos: antialiased premultiplied byte-RGB Lanczos3 with signed lobes, retained support normalized at edges, output-only half-up byte rounding and alpha/color clamping. Fixed chain cropped source -> 4x 840x752 -> 2x 420x376 -> 1x 210x188; no quantized upsampling.
bundle_report.semantics: One owner-neutral illustrated infantry portrait shared only by CP_infantry and EC_infantry. No faction recolouring, moved/spent grayscale, flags, text, frame, icons, or UI baked into this illustration. Source is the opaque art target, not a faction mask.

bundle_report_path_convention: Paths in bundle_report are relative to a fresh CLI output, except source.source which is relative to the manifest directory. Public PNG mappings use exports[].build_output.
